text:
Jordan (new-hire): Hey folks, first day! Quick Q: where's the single source of truth for onboarding templates (RFC/runbook) in Notion? Some pages I open are view-only. Who do I ask to get duplicate/edit rights?

ellie_peopleops: Welcome Jordan :tada: Canonical spot is Notion > Company Home > Templates > Team Templates and Eng space > Onboarding. If a page is view-only click Request access or DM me your work email and I'll add you to the Engineering Editors group.

marc_docs: Hi! If you hit view-only, use the Request access flow and include a short reason like "ramp + need RFC copy". That makes a docs ticket. If you tag @marc_docs in the request I can fast-track approval. Note: some templates are duplication-restricted to protect canonical copies.

sam_eng: Also FYI: pages under Team Restricted (SRE/Infra) are blocked unless you're a member. If you need a temporary copy of a restricted runbook for onboarding, ping me + ellie_peopleops with the reason and duration.

Jordan (new-hire): Thanks  my email is jordan@redwood.com. I mainly need to duplicate the RFC template into my private workspace and link to my ramp doc.

docs-bot: docs-requests - ticket DR-9123 created for jordan@redwood.com (requested by ellie_peopleops). Link: https://notion.company/requests/DR-9123

marc_docs: Approved DR-9123, adding Jordan to Engineering Editors now. You should get a Notion invite shortly. When you copy the RFC, please update the metadata at top (owner/date) and remove internal-only links.

Jordan (new-hire): Invite came through, thanks! One quick naming Q: draft RFCs vs final?

sam_eng: Prefix drafts with "WIP -" and save them in Eng > RFCs > Drafts. When final, remove the WIP prefix and move to Eng > RFCs > Published. Also set the status property (Draft/Review/Final).

Jordan (new-hire): Great, appreciated — excited to be here :raised_hands:
